notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
sslscan tests SSL/TLS configurations for weaknesses: protocol versions (SSLv2/3, TLS 1.0/1.1 deprecated), weak cipher suites (RC4, 3DES, EXPORT), certificate validity/expiry, and BEAST/POODLE/HEARTBLEED vulnerability indicators.

=== CHAINING ===
Target enumeration reveals HTTPS services → sslscan target:443 → identify weak protocols/ciphers → report findings: TLS 1.0/1.1 = Medium, SSLv3 = High, EXPORT ciphers = Critical (DROWN).

=== COMMON FINDINGS ===
TLS 1.0/1.1 still enabled (common in legacy apps), RC4 cipher suites (deprecated), self-signed certificates (no identity validation), certificate CN mismatch.
